_notes: The Mad Balloon / Krazy Balloon physics. Most balloon motion in the shipped binary is direct thrust; the pendulum-swing sine oscillator is DEAD CODE (routine 0x339e has no callers, no sine table present). Gravity/buoyancy/thrust as forces are NOT implemented (RECOVERED negative). Swing values here are playable reconstructions, clearly labelled.
coordinateUnits: pixels; logical play field 160x160, status bar top 16px, play window 160x144

fpsSmooth.note: frame delay 4 ticks at a5@(492) set 0x388; SysTicksPerSecond=100 (documented OS const)

startX.note: global default; per-level start overrides from descriptor+4/+6

slowMoFactor.note: asrl #1 halves dx and dy when action bit 4 held

gravity.note: NO gravity force in balloon update; verified absent

thrust.note: thrust == direct move step above; no acceleration model

swing._note: Pendulum oscillator code at 0x339e (1024-step sine, table a5@(132)) ships DISABLED (caller 0x3388 has zero callers; sine table never built). Values below are playable defaults for a faithful remake, NOT recovered.

angleStepsPerCircle.note: 10-bit angle in the dead trig routine

oscillatorSpeeds.note: ping-pong scenery hazard speeds; the real moving menace in shipped build
